article.title: KPMG與GS1香港報告：信任AI與願意分享資料仍有落差
article.title_en: KPMG and GS1 Hong Kong report a gap between AI trust and data-sharing comfort
article.summary: 11月4日發布的研究指出，香港與大灣區其他城市在AI信任及銀髮消費取向上呈現差異。
article.summary_en: The November 4 release describes differences in AI trust and older consumers’ shopping priorities between Hong Kong and other GBA cities.
highlights: 研究把透明度、準確性與人工支援列為建立信任的要點。
銀髮市場的價格、品牌及體驗取向需按地區分開理解。
highlights_en: The report emphasizes transparency, accuracy and human support.
Price, brand and experience priorities among older shoppers differ by market.
article.why: 零售品牌設計AI個人化服務時，應分開處理服務價值與資料授權，避免將信任視作同意。
article.why_en: Retailers should separate the value of AI personalization from data consent rather than treating trust as permission.
article.next_step: 檢查AI客服及會員流程是否清楚解釋資料用途、提供人工轉接，並按市場分開測試訊息。
article.next_step_en: Check data-use explanations and human handoff in AI service and membership flows, testing messages by market.
article.detail: 這篇採用研究機構經新聞稿公布的結論，並非本報獨立重做消費者調查。原始問卷、完整樣本及調查執行方法未經本輪查閱，因此不引用比例，也不把結果推算至全部香港或大灣區居民。報告把香港較重視價格與其他城市較重視品牌、體驗的差異列為策略方向；實際品牌仍宜以自身顧客資料驗證。信任AI、願意分享資料與真正購買，是不同的判斷。
article.detail_en: These are attributed research conclusions, not an independently repeated survey. The full questionnaire, sample and fieldwork methods were not inspected, so percentages and population extrapolations are omitted. Brands should validate the reported market differences with their own customers. Trust, consent and purchase are distinct.
